title: Patient characteristics associated with the need for high doses of tenapanor hydrochloride in dialysis patients with hyperphosphatemia: A pooled analysis of three clinical trials
content:
by Nobuo Nagano, Shin Tokunaga, Shinji Asada, Masafumi Fukagawa, Tadao Akizawa

Trial registration
